# SmileLynn Pediatric Dentistry

> SmileLynn Pediatric Dentistry in Apollo Beach, FL provides comprehensive dental care for children with advanced technology including LightScalpel laser treatment, preventative services, and specialized care for special needs patients.

Led by Dr. Lynn and Dr. Stewart, SmileLynn specializes in pediatric dentistry with a focus on preventative care, early orthodontics, and innovative laser treatments. The practice serves families in the Apollo Beach area with a team-oriented approach to children's oral health.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Apollo Beach, Florida
- LightScalpel CO2 laser
- Preventative dental care
- Early orthodontics
- Special needs dentistry
- Tongue tie and lip tie treatment
- Dental sealants
- Nitrous oxide sedation
- Restorative dentistry
- Cavity prevention
- Oral health education
- Dr. Lynn and Dr. Stewart
- Dental anxiety management
- Child oral health development

## Core Services

- [Prevention Dentistry](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/prevention-dentistry): Preventative treatments, sealants, fluoride, and oral health education
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/restorative-dentistry): Fillings, crowns, extractions, and cavity treatment for children
- [Early Orthodontics](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/early-orthodontics): Early orthodontic options for bite correction and jaw development
- [Growth and Development](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/growth-and-development): Pediatric dental services monitoring children's growth and development
- [Anticipatory Guidance](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/anticipatory-guidance): Proactive oral health counseling and parental education for children

## Specialized Treatments

- [Tongue Ties & Lip Ties Treatment](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/tongue-ties-and-lip-ties): Laser frenectomy for tongue and lip tie release treatment
- [LightScalpel Laser Technology](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/lightscalpel-laser): LightScalpel CO2 laser technology for surgical dental procedures
- [Sedation Options](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/sedation-options): Nitrous oxide and oral sedation options for anxious children
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/special-needs-dentistry): Adaptive dental treatment for children with developmental disabilities
- [Advanced Materials and Technology](https://www.smilelynndental.com/service/materials-used): Digital X-rays, intraoral cameras, and advanced dental technology
